name: hcb-taobao
description: Shopping on Taobao and Tmall through the Taobao desktop client: keyword research and supplier shortlists, reading a listing's real price, SKUs and specs, resolving a variant into the cart, and talking to sellers. Drives the client's local CLI through a bundled companion that paces requests around the anti-bot throttle, tells a genuine empty result from a silent block, and recognises the failures the vendor CLI reports as success. Stops at the cart — the client exposes no checkout and paying stays with the user.

lock_mode.title: Client lock mode
lock_mode.description: What to do when another session is already driving the Taobao desktop client: off, warn, ask, deny.
